Designed for English information and digital contexts.
Letters, numerals, essential symbols and OpenType features demonstrate the typeface’s core capabilities in brand communications and digital products.

Capability overview

A TrueType variable font for English text and numerals, with one continuous weight axis from 400 to 700. Four named weights and built-in kerning support consistent typography across headlines and body copy.

95CHARACTERS

Letters, numerals and punctuation for English text and digital interfaces.

EnglishCHARACTER COVERAGE

A–Z, a–z and 0–9, with common punctuation. No Chinese glyphs.

3 TypesFONT FORMAT

TTF, OTF and WOFF2 formats for desktop design and web use.

400–700WEIGHT RANGE

One weight axis; presets at 400, 500, 600 and 700, with continuous adjustment.

Numeral System

Numerals are central to blockchain experiences. From asset values and transaction records to network data, high distinction and reliable alignment make complex information easier to scan, compare and trust.

01

Distinct

高辨识数字

Distinct numeral forms support faster recognition across asset values, transaction records and data-rich interfaces.

02

Proportional

比例数字

Each numeral uses a natural width based on its form, creating a smoother rhythm for headlines, body copy and brand communication.

03

Alignment

精准对齐

Clear decimal, currency and percentage positions create stable visual anchors, helping asset prices, transaction records and network data remain easy to scan and compare.

OpenType
features

OpenType features let the system adapt numeral forms and character styles to body copy, data-heavy interfaces and moments of emphasis, while maintaining clear hierarchy and a consistent visual expression.
